items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And the trombones were who, Claude? >> [INTERVIEWER] Claude Jones and Key Johnson.

ctx.x: And the trombones were who, Claude?
Claude Jones and Key Johnson. Thank you, thank you.
Horace had a way of arranging for the out chorus, what we used to shout choruses, always beautiful. Well, now it becomes (a power of a kind.) (Let me make a shout poster (?)) (The lead has changed.)
